title: 并行 Agent 的显式职责与集成所有权
summary: 多个开发 Agent 并行工作时，以明确模块/文件所有权、尽量独立 worktree、显式 integration owner 和最终跨分支一致性检查降低覆盖、职责漂移和隐性冲突。
proposed_rules: Each agent receives explicit scope and ownership boundaries.
Independent worktrees are preferred for genuinely parallel changes.
Shared ownership units require an explicit integration owner.
Compilation success is not sufficient evidence that semantic overwrites did not occur.
Cross-agent changes require an integration/reconciliation pass.

provenance.evidence_level: repeated project experience, repository artifact not yet located
provenance.note: Keep Candidate until backed by concrete ASS/other repo incidents or process artifacts.
